home.h1: Tell your council what your neighbourhood needs.
home.lead: Share a suggestion, report a civic problem, or give feedback on local services. Neighbours can support it, and the council replies in public.
home.step1.d: Describe your idea or the problem. No account needed, and you can stay anonymous.
home.step2.d: Use it any time to check what is happening with your submission.
home.step3.d: Suggestions with more support rise to the top of the board.
home.step4.d: Officials review each entry, reply in public, and update its status.
home.empty.d: Be the first to share an idea for your neighbourhood.
home.choose: What would you like to do?
home.act.suggestion.d: Something that would make the area better
home.act.feedback.d: On a council service or decision
home.act.track.d: Use the code you were given
submit.lead: It takes about two minutes. No account needed.
submit.kind: What would you like to share?
submit.title: Title
submit.titlePh: e.g. Street light not working near the bus stand
submit.titleHint: One line that sums it up.
submit.similar: Already suggested? Supporting an existing entry gets it noticed faster.
submit.detailsPh: What is the situation, who does it affect, and what would you like the council to do?
submit.voiceError: Voice input did not work. Check the microphone permission and your internet connection.
submit.mapHint: Tap the map to drop a pin, then drag it to the exact spot. The pin is shown to everyone, so mark the place of the problem.
submit.gpsAccuracy: Your device reports this is accurate to about {n} m. Drag the pin if it is not on the exact spot.
submit.gpsDenied: Location permission was refused. You can still tap the map to place the pin.
submit.gpsUnavailable: Your location could not be found. Tap the map to place the pin.
submit.gpsInsecure: Browsers only share your location on secure (https) sites. Tap the map to place the pin.
submit.photoHint: A picture helps officials understand the problem. It will be visible to everyone.
submit.photoBad: That file could not be read as an image. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
submit.anon: Submit anonymously (your name is not shown)
submit.name: Your name
submit.contactHint: Never shown publicly. Only officials can see it.
submit.note: Your submission appears on the public board straight away.
submit.done.h1: Thank you. It's in the box.
submit.done.lead: Keep this tracking code to check progress later.
submit.done.remember: This browser also remembers it on the Track page.
browse.lead: Support the ones you agree with. The council sees what matters most.
browse.none.d: Try a different keyword, or share the idea yourself.
detail.notFeasible: Reviewed and marked as not feasible. See the council reply for the reason.
detail.shareHint: More support helps the council prioritise. Send this to your neighbours.
detail.noComments: No comments yet. Add detail or say why this matters to you.
detail.notFound.d: Check the tracking code and try again.
detail.fixed.hint: The council marked this as implemented. Tell everyone what you see on the ground.
detail.fixed.summary: {yes} say it is fixed · {no} say not yet
detail.fixed.thanks: Thank you. Your answer is recorded.
report.title: Report to moderators
report.done: Thank you. Moderators will take a look.
track.lead: Enter the tracking code you received when you submitted.
track.notFound: No submission found with that code. Check for typing mistakes.
dash.lead: How residents are using the suggestion box, and how {body} is responding.
dash.kpi.overdue: waiting more than {days} days for a first response
dash.kpi.fixed: of residents confirm the work was really done
map.lead: Each pin marks the exact place of a suggestion or problem. Tap a pin for details.
map.none: No pinned submissions match those filters.
map.error: The map could not be loaded.
polls.lead: Help {body} decide. One vote per browser.
polls.none: There are no polls right now.
poster.lead: Print this and put it up at ward offices, bus stands and shops. Scanning the code opens the submit page.
poster.url: Website address printed on the poster
poster.urlHint: Phones must be able to open this address. Once the site is hosted, use its public web address.
poster.headline: Have an idea for your neighbourhood?
poster.foot: No app and no account needed
